name: @dweb/client-sdk
description: dweb application-level fabric SDK for Node (napi-rs binding)

scripts.build: napi build --platform --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin --no-js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='index.d.ts';let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace(/=> any/g,'=> void');fs.writeFileSync(p,s)"
